hook: Ever wondered how AI breakthroughs happen so fast?
body: OpenAI just pulled back the curtain on how they're using internal coding agents to accelerate their own AI research. These agents are reshaping how new AI models are built, dramatically boosting experiment velocity and tackling complex tasks. This peek inside shows a future where AI development itself is supercharged by AI, offering invaluable insights for developers working on the next generation of tools.
